body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> 'Tablet Home', a home hub device with media convergence and strengthened home network was made public. ENSPERT's foreign market penetration kicks into high gear in parallel with domestic launching. ENSPERT pushes forward export with large Japanese and U.S. companies.

ENSPERT specialized in media convergence (CEO, CS Lee, www.enspert.com) surprisingly made public "Model: S200U", the Android-based 'Tablet Home' device (SoIP: Service Over IP) at CES, the biggest international exhibition for home appliances.

"S200U" of ENSPERT is a smart home device with strengthened function for home networking function and media convergence based on monitoring and controlling of various devices including home appliances, sharing of media and the mounted smart-grid function.

It features the optimized home convergence environment through the provision of Smart-grid function, together with Smart Networking Functions that support DLNA (Digital Living Network Alliance), Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, depending on the type of services.

Also, 'S200U', equipped with the N-Screen platform can be freely linked with various devices, such as smartphones, tablets and smart TVs, and transfer or share the media content through convergence, and, through cloud interworking, provides gateway function for FNS (Family Network Service) between families.

Besides, 'S200U' provides 1GHz CPU, Android-based VoIP video calls function and DECT (Digital Enhanced Cordless Telecommunications) type wireless handsets interworking, and so on. ENSPERT plans to enforce the follow-up lineup through the introduction of various functions by Home Hub Device.

While targeting the domestic launching in January, ENSPERT will also plan to hit its stride in its launching of "S200U" overseas, starting at 2011 CES. For this, vigorous negotiation with large Japanese and U.S companies for export is in process.

CEO, Lee, Sangsoo said that "'Tablet Home' will evolve into the cutting-edge hub grid devices that correspond to the connected home smart era where all the devices and the services are integrated in IP" and he spoke of his aspiration that "ENSPERT will lead the market both home and abroad based on the world first introduced technology"
<AVING Special Report Team for 2011 International CES: Ideak Kim, Kevin Choi, Joseph Choi, Paul Shin, Jun Lim, Daniel Kim, Ashley Kim, Sohpia Kwag, Mia Eun, Sena Moon, Jiny Kim, Astin Jung>
